title: Mary J. Blige Slates End of 20-Date Las Vegas Residency at Park MGM
summary: My Life, My Story has 10 remaining shows between October & February.
contentText:
After a 20-date run, Mary J. Blige is concluding her Las Vegas residency reign. Mary J. Blige: My Life, My Story at Dolby Live at Park MGM still has 10 remaining dates between October 2026 and February 2027 when the residency will end. Those dates include Halloween, Valentine’s Day weekend and President’s Day weekend.

In announcing the conclusion of her Park MGM shows, Blige stated, “This residency felt like divine timing. I’ve seen so many of you in Vegas and we still have 10 dates left. I feel even more grateful and deeply inspired after every show. Grab your girlfriends, your boots, and I’ll see you in Vegas in October and February.”

The remaining October dates are: Oct. 23-24, Oct. 28 and Oct. 30-31. The five dates in February 2027 are: Feb. 12-13, Feb. 17 and Feb. 19-20. All shows begin at 8 p.m. local time. For additional ticket information, visit here .

Rock & Roll Hall of Famer Blige launched My Life, My Story — her first-ever Vegas residency — on May 1. This followed the success of Blige’s For My Fans Tour in 2025. That tour included an April 10 stop in New York City, where the nine-time Grammy winner attained another career milestone: performing her first sold-out headlining show at Madison Square Garden. Livestreamed globally, that achievement was later spotlighted in the theatrical concert film Mary J. Blige: For My Fans, Live From Madison Square Garden , released globally in November 2025.

The “Queen of Hip-Hop Soul” released her latest album,  Gratitude , in November 2024. Blige recently extended her long association with Lifetime, the cable and satellite television network. The latest project under that partnership is the film  Mary J. Blige’s Be Happy, which aired in February.
